doc: Q306: the SEARCHABLE NAMES of the functional muscle groups the pages already carry. Q298 shipped 108-110 groups per page but only the 17 named textbook groups of data/anatomy/muscle_groups_q283.json had names a user could type: the 87 groups derived from the cited action data and the 6 extras of data/anatomy/relations_q298.json had none, so searching 'hip flexors', 'knee extensors' or 'pes anserinus' returned nothing on every page (measured in docs/research/Q306_search_coverage_audit.md). This file adds the names only. It also carries a corrected display label where the generated one used the pose rig's own words -- 'The opposite of rotation at the hip joint' -> 'External (lateral) rotation at the hip joint', 'Radial at the radiocarpal (wrist) joint' -> 'Radial deviation ...', 'Flexion at the f2 dip' -> 'Flexion at the index finger distal interphalangeal (DIP) joint'. `label_was` keeps what the page printed before so the change is auditable. MEMBERSHIP IS NOT DEFINED HERE.
he_note: HEBREW IS A PROJECT-SUPPLIED TRANSLATION, NOT A PUBLISHED TERMINOLOGY -- the same declaration data/anatomy/synonyms_q298.json carries in sources.he.
